info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Delete Payments Payments Void-v4-spec
info.description: The Payments Void Management API enables users to efficiently manage the voiding of payment transactions. This endpoint allows for the deletion of specific payment records that have been previously processed, ensuring accurate financial reconciliations. Typical consumers of this API include finance departments and payment processing systems that require the ability to cancel or reverse transactions when needed. By using this API, organizations can maintain accurate accounting records and streamline their payment management workflows.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to cancel a previously processed payment transaction. Once a payment is voided, it cannot be reversed. Make sure to verify the payment status before performing this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters required for voiding a payment. It should include all necessary information to identify the payment to be voided, ensuring the deletion process is executed accurately.

201.description: The void operation completed successfully and the payment has been reversed.

DeletePaymentsPaymentsVoidRequest.description: A string that represents the request body for the void operation in payments.
